title: Bigin template editor strips HTML comments, so Outlook conditional blocks disappear
symptoms: Outlook conditional comment blocks ([if mso]) are gone after saving
Hex colors come back as rgb()
The template is wrapped in an extra div
cause: Bigin's rich text editor normalizes stored HTML on save and drops comments. The bgcolor and align attributes survive.
fix: Do not rely on conditional comments. Set background colors with bgcolor attributes on tables and cells as well as in CSS, so clients that ignore CSS backgrounds still show the right color.
